items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-06
items.q: Evelyn St. Clair Moyers. Dave Burke? I was born in 1912, December the 13th.

ctx.x: This is being recorded on Tuesday night, the 6th of May, 1958. Did you give me the names, please?
Evelyn St. Clair Moyers. Dave Burke? I was born in 1912, December the 13th.
You were born in New Orleans?
